svg.title: Three learned circuit families in binary elimination
svg.desc: Of 10 final seeds, 6 used a layer 3 head readout, 2 diffuse layer 3, and 2 were complete by layer 2. All had final exact match 1.0 on 2000 held-out systems. Only 2 seeds passed the constant layer-3 substitution, without a reported complement test. Source: atlas entry (research report), https://github.com/jc1122/mechanistic-interpretability-circuit-atlas/blob/main/entries/gf2-elimination.md.

g.text: Final answer-only run: 10/10 seeds, exact on 2000 unseen-matrix systems
Dimension 4; circuit families from the source interpretation
Only the layer-2-complete group kept accuracy with layer-3 attention
replaced by a per-slot constant. This is not a whole-network formula.
